bar_close_ms.description: Close time of the bar that raised it, exchange milliseconds.

indicator.description: The indicator's title, as its legend shows it.

message.description: The `alertcondition` message; the title when the script gave none.

sequence.description: Increasing from 1 for the session; never reused.

symbol.description: The market of the tab whose chart raised it.

utc_ms.description: When the window delivered it, UTC milliseconds.

alarms.description: Oldest first; the session keeps the newest 256.

last_sequence.description:
The newest sequence ever raised (0: none yet). Pass it as `after` to
read only what comes next.
